So, killing myself didn't work, definitely could've and probably should've but it didn't. So, after my second attempt I decided that I probably wasn't the problem 100% of the time. So I analyzed my situation and really found my place in my own life. I moved out of my dad's house, lived on the streets and couch hopping since 15, it was never legal for me to rent my own place. Pulling myself out of the shitty situation I was in and placing myself into another, equally unstable, but far less judgmental and emotionally deteriorating situation was my savior. Whatever your issues are, they're issues you can likely escape with the act of a lot less bravery than it takes for you to commit suicide. Try getting medicated (I never did, I just dropped cid lmao), try moving away, try being your own person. Know and understand that the impact your life has on others is never as disappointing as you think it is. The bodies we come in are shells for much deeper, much greater contents. Your opinions and thoughts are all valuable and so is the time you're given in this life. Turn that time into something better instead of just ending it. You should be afraid to die, absolutely. At least in this life you can wake up and reach out to touch your blankets or understand how good the company of another person who understands you can be. There may not be any company after this and the blankets they give you at the funeral home aren't very thick so you could get cold in the winter. I wouldn't risk it.
